title: A chain build's draft copy is matched to the final plan before the copy run checks it
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A draft copy that still matches the final plan is left as it is.
A slot the final plan hides after the draft was written keeps no words, and W02 passes.
A plan label the final plan rewrote takes the final plan's words; a slot the draft never wrote is still reported missing.

tests: a draft that still matches the final plan comes back as the same object
a slot the final plan hides after the draft was written keeps no words, so W02 has nothing to send back
a plan label the final plan rewrote takes the final plan's words; a slot the draft never wrote stays missing
